=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:e2e_review_dispatch_resolve_head() function (added in both wait-review and verify-bait-removed steps, ~line 1505 and ~line 2410) | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The function does not explicitly handle `mktemp` failure, so a temporary-directory failure can be misreported as “Could not read the reviewed PR head.”
  WHY: When `TMPDIR` is full or unwritable, the caller's error message misattributes the cause.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:e2e_review_dispatch_pick() in wait-review step, line `pick_rows=$(printf '%s' "${pick_runs}" | jq -r ...)` | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `pick_rows` assignment does not report jq filter failures, which can leave the result empty and be treated as a silent no-match.
  WHY: An unexpected row field type can make jq fail, leaving the dispatch runs empty without logging that the listing was unusable.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:e2e_review_dispatch_resolve_head() (both inline copies) | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: An empty or partial job log is treated the same as a successful log fetch with no reviewed-head line.
  WHY: Both cases set the head to `none`, so triage cannot distinguish a partial log fetch from a job that did not write the expected line.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:e2e_review_dispatch_runs() in wait-review step | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The helper does not distinguish a malformed dispatch listing from documented cases that return an empty listing.
  WHY: Missing-wrapper, missing-default-branch, and malformed-listing cases can produce inconsistent failure messages.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_changes_lost_redispatch.sh:end of the step body | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The moved script may no longer set `CHANGES_LOST_REDISPATCHED`.
  WHY: If the export is missing, downstream conditionals or job-summary aggregation that use it receive an empty value.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:e2e_review_dispatch_resolve_head() (both inline copies) | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The function's `|| true` swallows grep's exit code and does not distinguish an empty or unreadable log from a successful fetch with no captured head.
  WHY: A flaky or partial log fetch yields the same “none” verdict as a genuine “ran the wrong code” defect.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:e2e_review_dispatch_runs() in wait-review step | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The function does not distinguish documented cases that return an empty listing from a malformed listing.
  WHY: Missing-wrapper, missing-default-branch, and malformed-listing cases produce inconsistent failure messages.

  PROBLEM: The moved script may not preserve the `CHANGES_LOST_REDISPATCHED` export.
  WHY: If it is no longer set, downstream conditionals or job-summary aggregation that use it see an empty value silently.
